title.zh: 混沌与三体 · 初始差一丝，结果天壤
title.en: Chaos and the Three-Body Problem · Tiny Differences, Huge Outcomes

desc.zh: 规则完全确定，结果却无法长期预测：从一个迭代公式，到洛伦兹的蝴蝶，再到三颗星的追逐。
desc.en: The rules are fully deterministic, yet long-term prediction fails: from a one-line map to Lorenz’s butterfly to three stars chasing each other.
